top_findings: Missing robots, sitemap, canonical, social metadata, favicon, and approved canonical origin
Generic positioning and thin buyer-evaluation content across all four routes
Header Sign-in link routes to Contact and the mailto conversion flow adds friction
No structured data and very limited entity, trust, or first-party proof signals
Homepage WebGL adds a material but not field-measured JavaScript/performance risk
quick_wins: Confirm the production hostname and publish robots, sitemap, and canonicals
Add favicon and approved social preview metadata

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All public routes are statically prerendered
Core content is present in HTML
Internal links reach every route
No noindex or crawler-blocking directive was found

findings.title: Crawl discovery and canonicalization files are absent
findings.description: The local production export returns 404 for robots.txt and sitemap.xml and emits no canonical links.
findings.recommendation: After confirming the canonical HTTPS hostname, add metadataBase, route canonicals, robots.ts, and sitemap.ts and verify root deployment.

findings.title: Deployment security and redirect policy is unknown
findings.description: Static export delegates HTTPS redirects and response security headers to the host/CDN.
findings.recommendation: Validate one-hop HTTP-to-HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, content-type, framing, and referrer policy on the real deployment.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage states a product category and audience
Product page has a logical capabilities and process hierarchy
Copy is readable and brand-consistent

findings.title: Positioning is broad and unsupported by proof
findings.description: Pages do not identify a concrete priority workflow, industry, integration surface, measurable result, or public evidence.
findings.recommendation: Approve an ICP and workflow narrative, then add verified use cases, implementation details, and proof.

findings.title: All substantive routes are thin for their intent
findings.description: Rendered main content ranges from 79 to 188 words and omits decision-critical coverage.
findings.recommendation: Expand only with unique product mechanisms, objections, evidence, and next-step guidance.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One H1 per route
Generally logical heading nesting
Unique page descriptions
No orphan public routes

findings.title: Three page titles are generic and too short
findings.description: Product, About, and Contact titles are 14-16 characters and do not identify their unique intent.
findings.recommendation: Write concise intent-led titles and descriptions after messaging and keyword approval.

findings.title: Mobile navigation and CTA labels misrepresent the journey
findings.description: Primary navigation is hidden at 390px while Sign-in remains visible and points to Contact.
findings.recommendation: Provide mobile navigation and make the header CTA label/destination truthful.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Visible content can support a truthful basic entity graph once facts are confirmed

findings.title: No structured data is present
findings.description: No JSON-LD, Microdata, or RDFa markers were found in source or rendered pages.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization and WebSite schema, then page/breadcrumb and verified software/app markup where visible facts support it.

categories.name: Performance / Core Web Vitals
what_works: Static HTML renders primary copy
Animation pauses when hidden or offscreen
Mobile frame rate and DPR are capped
Reduced-motion styling exists

findings.title: WebGL homepage performance is a material unmeasured risk
findings.description: Homepage script references total about 1.29 MB raw / 304 KB local Brotli estimate and render two canvases.
findings.recommendation: Measure deployed mobile Lighthouse, traces, and CrUX before deciding whether to defer or replace the scene.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Core explanatory copy is server-rendered
Semantic headings and answer-style homepage lead exist
No repository-level AI crawler block was found

findings.title: Low citability and entity authority
findings.description: Generic claims lack named sources, evidence, expert identity, case studies, and structured entities.
findings.recommendation: Publish compact, verifiable answer sections and primary evidence after eligibility and trust foundations are complete.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Current image inventory is limited to small SVG assets
Decorative hero visual is hidden from assistive technology
No oversized raster content was found

findings.title: Future raster assets have no optimization pipeline
findings.description: images.unoptimized is appropriate for current SVG-only use but will not optimize future raster media.
findings.recommendation: Choose a CDN loader or build-time responsive AVIF/WebP process before raster publication.

phases.name: Phase 1: Launch eligibility and trust
items: Publish robots, sitemap, canonicals, favicon, and social metadata

phases.name: Phase 2: Relevance and evaluation depth
items: Expand Product with verified mechanisms and decision details
Add truthful proof, company, and legal content

phases.name: Phase 3: Entities and conversion
items: Add verified Organization/WebSite and supported page schema
Improve contact handling and privacy expectations

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring and iteration
items: Monitor Search Console and qualified conversion paths
Re-audit after the first SEO release

limitations: No deployed production URL or confirmed canonical hostname
No Search Console, CrUX, analytics, backlink, or live SERP data
SEO isolated renderer unavailable until an explicitly requested /seo setup
Deployment/CDN-injected metadata, redirects, headers, and crawl files could not be tested
